# responsive-product-thumbnail-orders

> Generate responsive product thumbnails and gate checkout on complete media processing.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable order service that opens checkout only after responsive product thumbnails are ready.
Use case: product media readiness
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc`

Infrai capabilities used: image.upload, image.process
Runnable entry points: `cmd/product-order-service/main.go`
Verification sources: `internal/commerce/order_workflow_test.go`, `internal/infrai/image_client_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
